js: (async()=>{ const L=window.__wolLearn, $=(s)=>document.querySelector('#wol-learn '+s), sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const all=[]; for (let k=0;k<20;k++){ L._go('quiz',{level:'torah'}); await sleep(60); for (let i=0;i<10;i++){ all.push($('.wl-q').textContent); $('.wl-opt').click(); await sleep(20); $('.wl-fb [data-wl=next]').click(); await sleep(20);} } const n=new Set(all).size; return 'torah rounds 20, asked '+all.length+', different '+n+', seen '+(L._state().seen||[]).length; })()

(async()=>{ const L=window.__wolLearn, $=(s)=>document.querySelector('#wol-learn '+s), sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); let best=''; for (let k=0;k<25 && !best;k++){ L._go('quiz',{level:'torah'}); await sleep(60); for (let i=0;i<10;i++){ const t=$('.wl-q').textContent; const lo=Math.max(...[...document.querySelectorAll('#wol-learn .wl-opt')].map(b=>b.textContent.length)); if (t.length>60 || lo>38){ best=t+' / '+lo; break;} $('.wl-opt').click(); await sleep(20); $('.wl-fb [data-wl=next]').click(); await sleep(20);} } return best; })()
